source: Independent main checkout plus the capture backend changes; no changes from PR #214.

runs.ignored_reason: Existing opt-in danmaku comparison image writer.

coverage: Headless capture, no-frame and invalid-size handling, RGBA channel order, tightly packed rows, and aspect-fit letterbox.
Subtitles and opt-in danmaku; stale generation or mismatched viewport plans are excluded.
P010 PQ source is tone-mapped to SDR while live video uniforms and output status remain unchanged.
Packed-alpha logical width, transparent letterbox, and straight-alpha RGBA output.
Published Flutter surface contents and identity survive capture; a subsequent real draw reproduces the original pixels.
Headless video retirement waits for a pending last-reader fence and retains the current frame on timeout.
limitations: Capture samples the original video planes and does not apply ArtCNN, FSR, or VSR enhancement; it need not match a live SR-enhanced frame pixel for pixel.
The hardware pixel tests ran through Windows OpenSSH on the Intel adapter. NVIDIA 4K HEVC plugin acceptance is recorded separately by the integration harness.

If renderer destruction cannot finish a bounded fence wait and the device is still valid, it deliberately retains the AVFrame to prevent decoder-pool reuse during a pending GPU read. This exceptional path may retain the associated decoder pool and GPU resources, not merely the small AVFrame wrapper.
log_encoding: Windows PowerShell UTF-16 logs normalized to UTF-8/LF, with trailing whitespace and extra final blank lines removed; output content preserved.
remote_source_hash_verification: All three source SHA256 values independently verified with Get-FileHash on the Windows build checkout after the final build.

static_analysis.result: Passed with warnings; warnings were not promoted to errors.

new_capture_diagnostics.message: Suggests as_chunks_mut::<4>() instead of chunks_exact_mut(4). No correctness issue; source was kept unchanged after runtime acceptance.
